subject.title: feat(plugins): mirror local coding sessions to a remote Beam receiver

question: Should the bundled Beam plugin retain the new local-only session-catalog runtime SDK seam to export explicitly selected local transcripts to a remote Gateway receiver?
rationale: The code is intentionally narrow, but it introduces both a new Plugin SDK package export and an operator-configured cross-Gateway transcript boundary; repository policy requires owner-visible confirmation for compatibility- and security-sensitive plugin API changes.

options.title: Accept the narrow local-only seam
options.body: Confirm that Beam may use the list/read-only active-catalog facade, keeping the subpath private-local-only and the current explicit-consent and redaction requirements.

options.title: Design a broader supported catalog API first
options.body: Pause this PR if external plugins should be able to consume active catalogs, then define the stable public contract, compatibility policy, and owner boundary before landing Beam mirroring.

recommendation.title: Accept the narrow local-only seam
recommendation.body: Confirm that Beam may use the list/read-only active-catalog facade, keeping the subpath private-local-only and the current explicit-consent and redaction requirements.

likelyOwner.reason: The available merged-history evidence connects steipete most directly to the Beam receiver, its documented bundled distribution decision, and this proposed sender path.
